result.topic_en: The page holds the end of Riemann's Latin doctoral petition of 29 October 1851, which submits his dissertation on the general theory of functions of a complex variable. It also has a German draft letter asking for replacement of lost printed sheets of the Göttingen Commentationes, an upside-down Latin address to the Dean, and sideways pencil calculations of sums Ω, Ω' involving logarithms, roots of unity and quadratic exponentials, with cases depending on m mod 4.

(rotated, left margin, calculations:)
$\Omega = -\frac{e(r,m)}{2m}\left(\log(1-\xi)+\varphi_0+2\sum_{1,\frac{m}{4}-1}\log(1-e^{\frac{2\sigma r}{m}2\pi i})\,e^{-\sigma^2\frac{r}{m}2\pi i}\right) \quad m\equiv 0 \bmod 4$
$\Omega = -\frac{e(r,m)}{2m}\left(\log(1-\xi)+\varphi_0+2\sum_{1,m-1}\log(1-e^{\frac{2\sigma r}{m}2\pi i})\,e^{-\sigma^2\frac{r}{m}2\pi i}\right) \quad m\equiv 1 \bmod 2$
$\Omega = -\frac{e(r,4m)}{2m}\sum_{1,\frac{m}{2}}\log\left(1-e^{(2\sigma-1)\frac{r}{m}2\pi i}\right)e^{-(2\sigma-1)^2\frac{r}{4m}2\pi i} \quad m\equiv 2 \bmod 4$
$\Omega = -\frac{e(r,m)}{2m}\left(\log(1-\xi)+\varphi_0+\sum_{1,\frac{m}{2}-1}\log 4(\sin\frac{\sigma r}{m}\pi)^2\,e^{-\sigma^2\frac{r}{m}2\pi i}\right) \quad m\equiv 0 \bmod 4$
$\Omega = \frac{e(r,4m)}{4m}\sum_{1,\frac{m}{2}}\log 4(\sin(2\sigma-1)\frac{r}{m}\pi)^2\,e^{-(2\sigma-1)^2\frac{r}{4m}2\pi i} \quad m\equiv 2 \bmod 4$
$\Omega = -\frac{e(r,m)}{2m}\left(\log(1-\xi)+\varphi_0+\sum_{1,m-1}\log 4(\sin\frac{\sigma r}{m}\pi)^2\,e^{-\sigma^2\frac{r}{m}2\pi i}\right) \quad m\equiv 1 \bmod 2$

$\Omega' = \sum_{1,\infty}\frac{e^{-\frac{n^2}{m}xi}}{n}(-1)^n \qquad x=\frac{r\,2\pi}{\ldots}$[?]
$=\sum_{1,m}\sum_{0,\infty} e^{\sigma^2\frac{r\,2\pi i}{m}}\frac{(-1)^{\sigma}}{\sigma+nm}$[?]
$\Omega' = \sum_{1,m}\int_0^\infty \frac{e^{\sigma^2\frac{r\,2\pi i}{m}}(-1)^{\sigma}x^{\sigma-1}}{1+x^m}\,dx = -\frac{\pi}{m}\sum e^{\sigma^2\frac{r\,2\pi i}{m}}\ldots$[?]
$= -\frac{1}{m}\sum\log(1+e^{\frac{2\sigma r}{m}2\pi i})\,e^{-\sigma^2\frac{r}{m}2\pi i}$
$= -\frac{e(r,m)}{m}\sum_{1,m}\log 4(\cos\frac{\sigma r}{m}\pi)^2\,e^{-\sigma^2\frac{r}{m}2\pi i}$
$\frac{(-1)^{\sigma}x^{\sigma-1}}{1+x^{2m}} \quad = -\frac{1}{m}\frac{\alpha^{\sigma-1}}{1+\alpha^m}$[?]
$\frac{\sum(-1)^{\sigma}x^{\sigma-1}}{\ldots}\ -\alpha^{\ldots}$[?]

methods.what: Case-split evaluation of a sum Ω, as a logarithmic sum over residues weighted by quadratic exponentials (Gauss-sum type), according to m mod 4
Rewriting the logarithmic sums by means of log 4 sin^2, using pairing of conjugate terms
Evaluation of the series Ω' by splitting into residue classes mod m and representing each class sum as an integral of x^{σ-1}/(1+x^m)
Resulting closed form of Ω' as a finite sum of log 4cos^2 weighted by quadratic exponentials
